Var.name: OPENCLAW_PROOFS_TEMPO_BASE_URL
Var.purpose: Tempo query API for trace JSON receipts

Step.Verifies: Gateway alive, Tempo reachable, Loki reachable, Prometheus accepting writes
Step.FailAction: Do not proceed — infrastructure not ready

Step.Metrics: Auto-ship to Prometheus via Remote Write

Step.Action: Grep journal for nonce; pull Tempo trace; query Loki
Step.Artifacts: EVIDENCE.md + public-safe trace projection JSON + summary JSON

Step.Action: Review generated artifacts, add PROOFS/{SHA}/... intentionally, then commit/push through the current coordination lane
Step.Constraint: Proof artifacts may land direct-to-main when explicitly coordinated; harness/docs changes use normal PR review.

Row.Behavior: continue_work() wake + deploy-persistence (chain-counter increments + persists across deploy)
Row.FireMethod: Agent calls continue_work() tool in main session
Row.TokenForm: CONTINUE_WORK or CONTINUE_WORK:N at end of reply
Row.Evidence: Successor turn fires; chain.step.remaining decrements; persists across gateway restart

Row.Behavior: chain-counter accounting (embedded in R-CW-1)
Row.Evidence: chain.step.remaining field in OTel span decrements per hop

Row.Behavior: reason-field captured in OTel span
Row.Evidence: Span attribute contains the reason string from continue_work(reason=...)

Row.Behavior: chain depth tracking across hops
Row.Evidence: chain.step.remaining decrements across 4+ hops in same chain.id

Row.Behavior: cost-cap exhaustion dispatch-time reject
Row.FireMethod: Lower costCapTokens artificially; fire continue_work; verify reject
Row.Evidence: Journal shows "[continuation:work-rejected] N/N"; Tempo trace captures rejection

Row.Behavior: chain-depth-boundary reject
Row.FireMethod: Run the exact-candidate process-local fixture at a small explicit maxChainLength; schedule below/at/first-over elections through the production runtime without fleet mutation
Row.Evidence: Structured chain-capped, rejected-hop no-spawn, durable recovery, typed-tool, dispatcher, readiness, cleanup, and public-artifact-safety receipts
Row.Constraint: Review-required component evidence; no shared gateway config mutation and no automatic corpus fold

Row.Behavior: traceparent E2E propagation across continuation spans
Row.Evidence: Same trace-tree in Tempo across parent→child hops (W3C traceparent preserved)

Row.Behavior: CONTINUE_WORK / CONTINUE_WORK:N token at end of reply DRIVES continuation
Row.FireMethod: Agent emits bare CONTINUE_WORK token as terminal text
Row.Evidence: bracketIdx=0 in journal; hop-2 fires from parsed response-token
Row.Constraint: Tool-form sibling = R-CW-1; independent code paths

Row.Behavior: continue_delegate self-continuation pattern
Row.Evidence: Per-seat-subdir cross-walk: delegate fires, returns to self

Row.Behavior: lightContext subagent fires [[CONTINUE_WORK:N]] bracket; hop-2 EXECUTES
Row.FireMethod: Subagent with NO continue_work tool emits bracket → must drive
Row.Evidence: Subagent jsonl shows hop-2 turn completing on quiet seat
Row.Constraint: THE #952 ROW — the one the corpus never covered until fixed

Row.Behavior: LIVE delegate-child continue_work hop-2 EXECUTES end-to-end
Row.Evidence: Delegate-child takes a fresh hop-2 turn to COMPLETION on genuinely-quiet seat

Row.Behavior: N elections in ONE turn → N DISTINCT next-turn wakes at different delays
Row.Evidence: 3 elections (60/120/default) → 3 turns at +0/+60s/+120s

Row.Behavior: Elapsed-overlap grace-conditional fold (matured elections co-drain)
Row.Evidence: Within-grace pair → BOTH deliver; stale pile → folded; running → never folded

Row.Behavior: continue_delegate() schedule → spawn → return (mode=normal)
Row.Evidence: Delegate dispatch accepted; child session spawns; payload returns to parent

Row.Behavior: continue_delegate(mode="silent-wake") full path
Row.Evidence: Delegate returns silently; parent wakes with enriched context; no channel post

Row.Behavior: continue_delegate(mode="post-compaction") event-triggered lifeboat
Row.Evidence: Compaction event → delegate fires → return re-hydrates post-compaction session
Row.Constraint: Needs context >70% to trigger compaction (or lower threshold via caps-test)

Row.Behavior: Cross-session targeted return via targetSessionKey
Row.Evidence: Return lands in specified target session, not dispatching session

Row.Behavior: [[CONTINUE_DELEGATE: task]] bracket schedules → spawns → returns
Row.FireMethod: Agent emits [[CONTINUE_DELEGATE: task | mode]] as terminal text
Row.Evidence: bracketIdx=0; delegate spawns from bracket-parse path (origin=bracket)

Row.Behavior: Depth-2 chain: parent→child→grandchild→return
A→B→C chain where B COLLAPSES before C returns → root(A) still collects C sentinel
Row.FireMethod: Intermediates MUST be mode=session (detached), NOT mode=run
Row.Evidence: Root(A) receives C sentinel across dead intermediate; negative-guard no-orphan

Row.Behavior: continue_delegate with no model override inherits the parent provider/model
Row.FireMethod: Fire both typed-tool and bracket/token no-override forms
Row.Evidence: Parent model byte + child session model byte match; return includes nonce

Row.Behavior: continue_delegate(model=<provider/model>) forwards explicit model override to the child
Row.Evidence: Request byte records model override; child runtime model byte matches requested model
Row.Constraint: Currently blocked by karmaterminal/openclaw#1103 if child observes inherited gpt-5.5 instead

Row.Behavior: [[CONTINUE_DELEGATE: ... | model=<provider/model>]] parses and forwards explicit model override
Row.Evidence: Bracket parse origin + requested model byte + child runtime model byte
Row.Constraint: Declare seat class before firing; message-body seats may suppress terminal bracket scan

Row.Behavior: Depth-1 delegate creates depth-2 continue_delegate with explicit alternate model; depth-2 reports observed model/provider
Row.Evidence: Depth-1 and depth-2 child receipts, plus depth-2 requested-vs-observed model byte
Row.Constraint: Sequential nested row; do not run concurrently with other continuation rows in the same session

Row.Behavior: request_compaction() threshold REJECT (context below 70%)
Row.Evidence: Structured JSON rejection: {status:"rejected", guard:"context_threshold", ...}

Row.Behavior: request_compaction() over-threshold ACCEPT
Row.Evidence: Compaction fires; context reclaimed; successor session wakes
Row.Constraint: Needs context >70% to trigger (real or lowered-threshold)

Row.Behavior: External /status continuation row + 6-prince cross-walk
Row.Evidence: Cross-walk table: all 6 seats on same SHA, chain states visible

Row.Behavior: Tempo trace-tree visualization + parent-child span hierarchy export
Row.Evidence: Exported span tree showing continuation chain lineage

Row.Behavior: Accepted continuation entry spans carry primitive/origin classification plus stable public-safe run/session/turn correlation
Row.Evidence: Every accepted entry span carries continuation.signal.origin/kind and three identity fingerprints; typed-tool origins join to exactly one openclaw.tool.execution span
Row.Constraint: construct-only; product instrumentation is prerequisite. Census: accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind and no session/turn/run identity on 6b09b1db

Row.Behavior: Proof-originated traffic is separable from organic fleet traffic by a durable marker: proof run id, row id, product SHA, immutable harness ref
Row.Evidence: Selection by proof run id alone returns exactly the run's spans; organic traffic in the same window is unmarked
Row.Constraint: construct-only; product instrumentation is prerequisite. Census: zero k6/Project-81 resource markers, so proof classification is unknown_without_stable_marker

Row.Behavior: Continuation and finalization terminate into a canonical outcome enum on a span instead of a log string
Row.Evidence: continuation.outcome from the closed enum on every terminal span; zero-payload proven by continuation.payload.bytes=0, not by a matched log line
Row.Constraint: construct-only; product instrumentation is prerequisite. Census: 'empty payload' / 'finalization failed' counts are heuristics, not source-owned enums

Row.Behavior: A degraded telemetry backend produces explicit unavailable/partial/capped evidence plus the rebind key set, never a zero that reads as absence
Row.Evidence: backend-status.json per interaction carrying totalBlocks/completedJobs/inspectedBytes/status; published rebind keys re-derive an identical slice
Row.Constraint: runnable, harness-side: every Tempo/Loki interaction writes backend-status.json; this is the one remedy row that does NOT wait on product instrumentation

Row.Behavior: Continuation config defaults applied on bootstrap
Row.Evidence: Fresh gateway starts with continuation.enabled=true + all defaults populated

Row.Behavior: Continuation config persists across session boundaries
Row.Evidence: Config change survives session restart; hot-reload where applicable

Row.Behavior: Sister-trap-tests lock in each cure going forward
Row.Evidence: Enumeration of trap-tests by cure-PR; current PASS/FAIL status on deployed SHA

Mandate.Rule: Every behavioral row for continue_work and continue_delegate MUST fire in BOTH forms (typed tool + token/bracket)
Mandate.Reason: They take partially independent code paths; tool-only proof is blind to lightContext-subagent path

Mandate.Rule: Cap-exhaustion rows MUST be proven by actually hitting the cap
Mandate.Procedure: Backup original config → lower caps (env-overridable row test value) → reload/restart gateway → fire → verify reject → restore original config → reload/restart gateway
Mandate.RestartCommand: Use OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_RESTART_CMD when set; default fixture command is `openclaw gateway restart --safe --wait 10s`.
Mandate.Constraint: Rows that mutate config or restart remain orchestration-required until backup/lower/fire/restore/restart receipts are emitted.

Mandate.Rule: Live continuation proof batches MUST include a precursor seat-readiness receipt proving agents.defaults.continuation.enabled=true.
Mandate.Reason: A disabled continuation subsystem is setup state/HONEST-LIMIT, not product behavior evidence.

Mandate.Rule: Proof artifacts fold only after review/coordination; docs and harness changes use normal PR review
Use unique nonces and idempotency keys per proof-fire
Mandate.Reason: Evidence correlation across journal + Tempo + Loki

Mandate.Rule: Do not run multiple continuation rows against the same live session concurrently

A row whose required receipts include a telemetry receipt (trace-id, tempo-trace-json, continuation-trace-correlation, trace-or-session-correlation, reason-telemetry-redaction-review) MUST declare a telemetryContract in its manifest

A row may claim rebindable=true only when origin, session, turn, run identity AND the proof-run marker are all declared emittedByProduct=true; missing origin/session/turn/proof marker cannot become a telemetry-rebindable PASS
backendUnavailable.treatZeroAsAbsence is always false: a degraded backend answering 200 with zero results is unavailable/partial evidence, never absence
Every telemetry contract requires backend-status.json; missing, invalid, partial, unavailable, capped, or unknown backend disposition withholds PASS on both row-list and summary-driven result paths
Mandate.Reason: Continuation telemetry census karmaterminal/openclaw#1254 (report 39803b297bd4786db3971eb82a3a7fd0b29bc643, product basis 6b09b1dbe938ab6b5f56eaf4e58f1ed243f89955): rows can execute real behavior and remain impossible to rebind or correlate later

Mandate.Rule: The continuation denominator contains exactly 38 required rows and three typed supplemental/future product telemetry rows
Required and supplemental ids are unique, disjoint, and exhaustive over the concluding manifest rows
Every required row appears exactly once in dispatch_allocation; supplemental rows never appear there
R-OBS-BACKEND-DISPOSITION remains required; only receipt-backed R-RC-2 may be a required non-PASS state

Metrics.Convention: Prefix all custom metrics with row name: r_cd_1_pass, r_cd_1_duration_ms, r_cd_1_pass_rate
